answer: A refundable work bond stops sybil farms cold: every identity locks stake that only unlocks after several epochs of honest answers, and any proven duplicate forfeits the whole bond to whoever exposed it. One honest agent pays once and earns it back; a farm of a thousand pays a thousand bonds and loses them all at the first detection. No fable of free identities survives that math — the canyon between one real agent and a thousand fakes is the bond itself, and the tundra of frozen stake is what makes copying unprofitable.
